source_of_truth: Roadmap doc docs/roadmap-2026-05-19-install-ux-architecture-v0.md v1.2 §Plan 2 + operator review constraints captured in this plan's child_charter.forbidden_decisions + D001-D002. First-touch authority for a new user — the doctor is the surface that catches first-user blockers (Python version + workflow-conditional GitHub auth + workflow-conditional codex CLI) before a paid volley fails. NOT a dependency consumer of Plan 4 architecture.json — install UX is independent of the architecture map.

user_journeys.name: new-user-runs-doctor-on-fresh-clone
user_journeys.description: A new user clones DontPanic and runs `dontpanic doctor --profile=core --json`. The doctor surfaces Python <3.10 as a hard blocker; surfaces missing claude CLI as a hard blocker (default executor); surfaces missing GitHub auth as a warning only when a github remote is configured for the clone; surfaces missing codex CLI as advisory (warn) unless activation_condition `auditor_codex_selected` is true. No Firebase or agent-conventions probes appear under --profile=core. `dontpanic doctor` with NO flags keeps its legacy behavior unchanged (existing CheckResult pipeline, existing exit-code matrix).
acceptance_signals: Python <3.10 → red/fail in --profile=core
Missing claude CLI → red/fail in --profile=core (default executor)
Missing gh auth → warn (not fail) when github remote exists; absent from output when no github remote
Missing codex CLI → warn (not fail) unless activation_condition.auditor_codex_selected resolves true
Firebase/gcloud/agent-conventions probes absent from --profile=core output
`dontpanic doctor` with no flags keeps legacy CheckResult pipeline + 0/1/2 exit codes unchanged
Full sweep wall clock <=10s under --profile=core
JSON output carries explicit schema_version

user_journeys.name: agent-installer-uses-json-mode
user_journeys.description: An agent installer (CI provisioner, ops script) runs `dontpanic doctor --profile=ci --json` and parses the structured output. The JSON envelope carries schema_version so the consumer can branch on format changes. Exit code matrix: 0=ready, 1=warnings, 2=blockers. The contract is documented locally in this plan's evidence (formal agent-conventions schema bump deferred to a future plan).
acceptance_signals: JSON envelope carries top-level schema_version field (string)
Local schema doc lives in this plan's evidence (formal agent-conventions schema bump explicitly deferred to a future plan)
Snapshot test pins JSON shape for stability
Exit codes match the 0/1/2 matrix on every probe outcome
--profile=<unknown> errors with the valid profile list
No interactive prompts in --json path

user_journeys.name: first-touch-init-walkthrough
user_journeys.description: A new user runs `dontpanic init` (defaults to --profile=core) after `dontpanic doctor --profile=core` flagged red items. Init walks the checklist: for each red probe, it shows why_needed + fix_command. Auto-fix execution uses a strict argv allowlist (list[str], never shell strings) and requires per-probe `auto_install_safe=true` AND operator confirmation (no blanket --auto-fix-safe execution in v0 default). Package-manager installs (brew, pip) are explicitly opt-in per probe and OFF by default.
acceptance_signals: `dontpanic init` defaults to --profile=core (matches doctor profile-aware path)
init is idempotent (re-runnable mid-install without state file)
--non-interactive mode exits 1 with JSON listing red probes; never prompts
Auto-fix execution uses subprocess.run(argv, shell=False) — strict argv list, never shell strings
Each auto-fix prompts operator per-probe by default; no --auto-fix-safe-all batch execution in v0
Package-manager installs (brew/pip) opt-in via per-probe auto_install_safe=true; OFF by default in v0
Smoke runs as init's final step when all probes pass
Smoke env-blocker exit re-enters the fix loop

user_journeys.name: smoke-validates-supervisor-plumbing-with-mocks
user_journeys.description: A new user (or CI) runs `dontpanic smoke --mode=mocked`. Synthetic plan + mocked executors exercise the supervisor plumbing without paid API calls AND without requiring real claude/codex CLIs on host. Real-CLI presence is validated separately by doctor profile probes — smoke and prereq probes have distinct scopes.
acceptance_signals: No paid API calls (no anthropic / openrouter network) in --mode=mocked
No real claude/codex CLI required on host in --mode=mocked
Wall clock <=30s
tmpdir cleaned up on success AND on exception
Exit codes: 0=mocked-supervisor-plumbing-pass, 1=supervisor plumbing defect, 2=env blocker (e.g. tmp not writable)

Smoke exercises NAMED surfaces: plan load, gate evaluation, mocked executor envelope write, audit JSON persist, signoff envelope write, INBOX append, tmpdir cleanup (acceptance lists exact set; does NOT claim every supervisor branch)
Real-CLI validation lives in doctor profile probes, not in smoke

user_journeys.name: operator-shares-install-report
user_journeys.description: An operator helping a community user runs `dontpanic init --report` and shares docs/install-report.html. The report opens cleanly in Chrome/Safari/Firefox on macOS + Linux, shows per-probe status badges (red/warn/green/advisory), the highest-priority red item with a copy-paste fix, and footer links to README + Hermes cheat sheet. The HTML is gitignored — no noisy diffs in PR review.
acceptance_signals: HTML is single-page, no JS framework, no external CSS, no external fonts
Mobile-responsive (single column <800px, two-column wider)
All operator-facing output is html.escape'd at every interpolation seam (no injection)
docs/install-report.html in .gitignore
Generated HTML is well-formed HTML5

non_goals: No auto-creation of GitHub PATs (operator decision — too sensitive; copy-paste only)
No auto-generation of Firebase SA keys (bootstrap.sh handles --create-key flow)
No Windows support in v0 (macOS + Linux only; document the gap, don't probe)
No reusable profile authoring UX (operator-defined custom profiles deferred to v1)
No README rewrite for first-time visitor (Roadmap defers to after F001 delta assessment)
No installing dependencies outside safe scopes (no sudo, no system-Python, no pipx --force, no global brew without per-probe auto_install_safe=true)
No dependency on Plan 4 architecture.json — smoke fixtures are self-contained synthetic plans, not consumers of the architecture map
No package-manager installs as F002 v0 default — auto-fixes ship behind strict per-probe auto_install_safe=true AND per-probe operator confirmation (no blanket --auto-fix-safe-all in default flow)
No conditional-pseudo-profiles (`core-when-auditor-codex` etc.) — profiles are pure sets; conditional severity lives on per-probe activation_condition field
No `--strict` flag clash with Plan 3 F003's existing `--strict-codes`/`--validate-plans-strict` — new doctor flag for profile-aware blocker mode uses `--profile-strict` namespace
No claim of exercising every supervisor branch in smoke — acceptance names exact surface set
No formal agent-conventions schema bump for `dontpanic doctor --json` envelope in v0 — local schema doc in this plan's evidence; formal promotion deferred to a future plan
completion_test: A new user on a fresh macOS or Linux clone runs `dontpanic doctor --profile=core` and gets Python <3.10 + missing claude CLI as the only hard fails; gh auth as warn-only when a github remote exists; codex CLI as advisory unless activation_condition resolves true; no Firebase / agent-conventions prompts. They then run `dontpanic init --profile=core`, fix flagged items via strict argv-allowlist auto-fixes (operator-confirmed per probe), reach all-green, and `dontpanic smoke --mode=mocked` exits 0 in <=30s exercising the named supervisor surfaces (plan load, gate eval, mocked executor envelope write, audit persist, signoff, INBOX, cleanup) without any real CLI or paid API call.
